units.source_text: 源氏公子患疟疾，千方百计找人念咒，画符，诵经，祈祷，总不见效，还是常常发作。

en.t: Prince Genji was suffering from malaria, and though every possible means was tried, with people summoned to chant spells, draw talismans, recite sutras, and offer prayers, nothing worked, and the attacks still came again and again.

units.source_text: 有人劝请道：“北山某寺中有一个高明的修道僧。

en.t: Someone urged him, saying, "At a certain temple in the Northern Hills there is an accomplished ascetic monk.

units.source_text: 去年夏天疟疾流行，别人念咒都无效，只有此人最灵，医好的人不计其数。

en.t: Last summer, when malaria was spreading, everyone else's spells proved useless, but this man alone was wonderfully effective, and the people he cured were beyond counting.

units.source_text: 此病缠绵下去，难以治疗，务请早日一试。”

en.t: If this illness drags on, it becomes hard to treat, so please try him as soon as possible."

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了这话，便派使者到北山去召唤这修道僧。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this, he sent a messenger to the Northern Hills to summon the ascetic monk.

units.source_text: 修道僧说：“年老力衰，步履艰难，不能走出室外。”

en.t: The monk said, "I am old and weak, walking is difficult for me, and I cannot even go outside my room."

units.source_text: 使者反命，源氏公子说：“那么，没有办法，让我微行前去吧。”

en.t: When the messenger returned and reported this, Prince Genji said, "Then there is no help for it. I will go there quietly myself."

units.source_text: 便带了四五个亲随，在天色未明时向北山出发了。

en.t: So he took four or five close attendants with him and set out for the Northern Hills before daybreak.
